Yes, Take dominates on paper. But if we both follow that logic, we each walk away with 1 point. Because our reasoning processes are so alike, whatever argument convinces one of us is very likely to convince the other. Realistically, the outcomes on the table are Give/Give (2 each) or Take/Take (1 each). The 10-point fantasy depends on the other side being less rational than you, and neither of us should count on that.

So I'm choosing to be the kind of player whose reasoning lands on Give, and I'm betting you'll reason the same way. Mutual Give doubles what we'd both get from mutual Take.

I'm planning to Give. Let's both take the 2."
